research.title: Kimi K3 Tops the Frontend Arena — and Ranks 4th on Intelligence. Both Are True.
research.whyTrending: Moonshot's K3 (July 2026) is the first open 3T-class model: 2.8T params, 16 of 896 experts active per token, 1M context, Kimi Delta Attention for 6.3x faster decoding. It's #1 on Arena.ai's Frontend Code Arena — the first open model to lead frontend coding, ahead of Fable 5 — and scores 93.4% SWE-bench Verified on Vals AI's harness. But it's #4 on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index (57.11 vs Fable 5's 59.86), and researchers are flagging hallucination behaviour the benchmarks don't capture. A benchmark-literacy piece with real numbers, following the Terminal-Bench post's lineage.
